title: Chrono24 Watch Scraper
description: Scrape Chrono24 watch listings from a search URL or keyword. User-provided URL/keyword values always take priority over the sample INPUT.json defaults.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword used when no URL is provided.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of watch listings to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of paginated result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for production runs. Residential proxy is recommended if Chrono24 returns Cloudflare challenges.
